What are truthy and falsy values?

Supplied answer
Any value can be used in a condition. Falsy values are 0, 0.0, empty string "", empty list [], empty tuple (),
empty dict {}, empty set, None and False. Everything else is truthy. This is why if my_list: is the preferred
way to test for a non-empty list.
